title: sendKeysVerified re-sends the same narration up to 3x when the idle gate times out: the delivery oracle's precondition (idle pane) is provably violated at exactly that moment
description:
OBSERVED LIVE (ship of PR #298): the same `[cam]` narration line arrived in the orchestrator pane THREE times. Grounding proves this is a send-layer defect, distinct from CAM-361 (which is about the 30s BLOCKING window, not duplication).

MECHANISM (all cited, src/tmux/dispatch.ts):
- :503 `waitForIdlePane` returns timedOut=true when the pane never goes idle within IDLE_WAIT_DEADLINE_MS (30_000, :256).
- :504-509 the ONLY consequence is a stderr warning. No return, no flag, no maxAttempts reduction. Control falls through into the retry loop.
- :512 `for (attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++)` with maxAttempts default 3 (:480). The send at :519 is UNCONDITIONAL inside the loop body.
- :529-539 delivered = (baseline !== null && after !== null && geometryUnchanged(...)) && cursorRowStartsWithPrompt(...). The only break is :537.
- There is NO de-duplication, idempotency key, or already-sent guard anywhere between :512 and :550. `delivered` is set ONLY by a successful verification, never by the act of sending.

RESULT: up to 3 REAL deliveries of the same payload per call. tmux send-keys always succeeds at the transport level, so each retry genuinely lands.

THE CRUX, MEASURED 2026-07-20 on the live orchestrator pane (238x76) while it was BUSY mid-response: `tmux list-panes -F '#{cursor_x},#{cursor_y}'` read `2,72`, and the cursor row content started with the prompt glyph U+276F. That is byte-INDISTINGUISHABLE from an idle empty composer. The oracle's measured basis (dispatch.ts:38-46, :347-354) is explicitly scoped to an IDLE pane; there is no measurement in the source for a pane that is mid-response, spinning, or streaming.

So the logical hole is precise and does not depend on further probing: when the idle gate TIMES OUT, the code KNOWS the oracle's precondition is violated, and it nonetheless consults that oracle and retries on its verdict. The idle gate uses pane CONTENT (isOrchPaneIdle) and correctly detects busy; the delivery oracle uses cursor GEOMETRY and provably cannot.

PROPOSED FIX (direction, not a mandate): when waitForIdlePane reports timedOut, send exactly ONCE and do not enter the verify/retry cycle, emitting the existing 'push-undelivered' observational event (:552-554) instead of a verdict the oracle is not entitled to render. Delivering a best-effort narration line once-unverified is strictly better than delivering it three times.

Sidecar-executed (host.ts:330 -> dispatch.ts), so this needs a coherence rebuild.

NOT to be conflated with CAM-361: that issue covers the 30s SYNCHRONOUS stall of the sidecar outer loop. This one is the duplicate delivery. They share a trigger (busy pane) but have different fixes and different blast radii.

spec.scope:
Stop sendKeysVerified (src/tmux/dispatch.ts:469) from re-sending the same payload up to 3 times when the pre-send idle gate has timed out, and make the resulting push-undelivered event honestly distinguish the two failure modes.

THE DEFECT, exactly. At :503 `const timedOut = waitForIdlePane(...)`. At :504-509 the ONLY consequence of timedOut===true is a stderr warning: no return, no flag, no maxAttempts reduction. Control falls through into `for (attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++)` at :512 whose send at :519 is UNCONDITIONAL, whose only break is at :537, and which has NO de-duplication guard of any kind. `delivered` (:511) is set ONLY by a successful geometry+prompt-row verdict, never by the act of sending. Result: up to 3 REAL deliveries (maxAttempts default 3, :480). tmux send-keys always succeeds at the transport level, so every retry genuinely lands.

WHY THE ORACLE IS NOT ENTITLED TO A VERDICT THERE. The delivered test at :529-539 is geometry-based (geometryUnchanged) plus the start-anchored prompt-row discriminator (cursorRowStartsWithPrompt, :375-380). Its measured basis is documented at :38-46 and :347-354 and is explicitly scoped to an IDLE pane. MEASURED 2026-07-20 on the live 238x76 orchestrator pane while it was BUSY mid-response: cursor read (2,72) with the cursor row starting with U+276F, i.e. byte-INDISTINGUISHABLE from an idle empty composer. The idle gate uses pane CONTENT (isOrchPaneIdle) and correctly detects busy; the delivery oracle uses cursor GEOMETRY and provably cannot. So at the exact moment the gate reports timedOut, the code KNOWS the oracle's precondition is violated and consults it anyway, then retries on its verdict.

CHANGE 1 (src/tmux/dispatch.ts). When waitForIdlePane reports timedOut, perform EXACTLY ONE send-keys and do NOT enter the verify/retry cycle: no geometry sampling for a delivery verdict, no backoff sleep, no second or third send. Keep the existing stderr warning. Then emit the existing 'push-undelivered' event once. Delivering a best-effort narration line once-unverified is strictly better than delivering it three times. When the gate does NOT time out, behavior must remain byte-for-byte what it is today.

CHANGE 2 (src/supervisor/events.ts). PushUndeliveredEventDetail (:528-539) gains a REQUIRED discriminator `reason: 'retries-exhausted' | 'pane-not-idle'`. Required, not optional, deliberately: an optional field would let existing emit sites and any fake keep modelling a shape that cannot tell the two modes apart, and this repo has twice shipped bugs from fixtures encoding a wrong process model (CAM-363 decision 2, CAM-364 decision 2). The compile break at the existing emit site is INTENDED; resolve it by passing 'retries-exhausted' there, never by weakening the type to optional. Update the interface doc comment to define both values. `retriesExhausted` stays and carries 1 on the pane-not-idle path (one attempt made).

CHANGE 3 (module header + docs). The dispatch.ts header and the JSDoc at :160, :181 and :465 currently describe push-undelivered as emitted 'on exhaustion' / 'once all attempts' only. Correct them to name BOTH paths. Follow CAM-364 decision 4: do not overclaim. State plainly that on the pane-not-idle path the line is sent once and NOT verified, so its delivery is genuinely unknown rather than confirmed.

OUT OF SCOPE, do not touch: CAM-361's blocking window. IDLE_WAIT_DEADLINE_MS (:256) and SEND_KEYS_SETTLE_MS (:240) MUST keep their current values; retuning them is CAM-361's job and doing it here would entangle two separate defects. Do not make sendKeysVerified or sendKeysWhenIdle async. Do not touch isOrchPaneIdle, geometryUnchanged, or cursorRowStartsWithPrompt. Do not change maxAttempts, retryBaseMs, retryMaxMs, or the backoff computation. Do not add dedup/idempotency caching for the non-timeout path.
acceptanceCriteria: AC1 (BEHAVIORAL, the core fix): a unit test in test/dispatch.test.ts drives sendKeysVerified with an injected sleepFn+fake clock so the idle gate TIMES OUT (pane content never idle), and asserts the tmuxSpawnFn received EXACTLY ONE 'send-keys' invocation. Oracle is red on main today: main sends maxAttempts (3) times in this state.

AC2 (BEHAVIORAL): in that same timed-out state, assert that ZERO backoff sleeps occur (the recorded sleep sequence contains no computeBackoffMs-derived value) and that the geometry sampler is NOT consulted for a delivery verdict. Distinguish this from AC1 so a fix that merely caps attempts at 1 while still verifying and sleeping does not pass.
AC3 (BEHAVIORAL): in that same timed-out state, exactly ONE 'push-undelivered' event is emitted, and its detail carries reason === 'pane-not-idle' and retriesExhausted === 1.

AC4 (REGRESSION, non-timeout path must be untouched): the existing test at test/dispatch.test.ts:369 ('geometry unchanged after settle: delivered on first attempt, no retry, no push-undelivered') and the existing test at :435 ('geometry never returns to baseline: retries up to maxAttempts, then emits one push-undelivered event') both still pass, with :435 now additionally asserting reason === 'retries-exhausted'. All 34 pre-existing tests in test/dispatch.test.ts still pass; none may be deleted or weakened.

AC5 (TYPE, required-not-optional): `sed -n '/interface PushUndeliveredEventDetail/,/^}/p' src/supervisor/events.ts | grep -q "reason"` succeeds, AND the field is NOT declared optional: the same extracted block must NOT match `reason?`. Both halves required. Red on main: the block has no reason field at all.

AC6 (TYPE, both variants exist): `grep -q "'pane-not-idle'" src/supervisor/events.ts` AND `grep -q "'retries-exhausted'" src/supervisor/events.ts` both succeed. Red on main: neither string literal appears anywhere in src/ or test/.
AC7 (EMIT SITES, both wired): `grep -q "pane-not-idle" src/tmux/dispatch.ts` AND `grep -q "retries-exhausted" src/tmux/dispatch.ts` both succeed. Red on main: dispatch.ts contains neither.

AC8 (REAL-TMUX TIER): a new test in test/integration/dispatch-geometry.test.ts, following the existing test.skipIf pattern at :101/:134/:162, drives a REAL tmux pane that is NOT idle (a pane running a long-lived foreground command, so isOrchPaneIdle is false) and asserts sendKeysVerified issued exactly ONE send-keys and emitted one push-undelivered with reason 'pane-not-idle'. Must use a real tmux server and real panes, never a fake spawn, matching that file's existing convention. Use an explicitly short idleTimeoutMs override so the test does not wait the 30s default.

AC9 (NO TIMING DRIFT, guards the CAM-361 boundary): `grep -q 'IDLE_WAIT_DEADLINE_MS = 30_000' src/tmux/dispatch.ts` and `grep -q 'SEND_KEYS_SETTLE_MS = 50' src/tmux/dispatch.ts` both still succeed after the change. Red-capable: if a worker retunes either constant this criterion fails, which is exactly the CAM-361 entanglement this forbids.

AC10 (NO ASYNC DRIFT): sendKeysVerified and sendKeysWhenIdle both still declare a synchronous `: void` return. `grep -q 'export function sendKeysVerified(opts: SendKeysVerifiedOptions): void' src/tmux/dispatch.ts` succeeds and `grep -qi 'async function sendKeysVerified' src/tmux/dispatch.ts` FAILS.

AC11 (HONEST DOCS): the dispatch.ts module header and the JSDoc for logEvent and maxAttempts no longer describe push-undelivered as exclusively an exhaustion signal, and explicitly state that on the pane-not-idle path the payload is sent once and its delivery is NOT verified. Verified by reading the diff, not by grep alone.
AC12 (GATES): `bun run typecheck` zero errors, `bun test` zero failures with a total pass count STRICTLY GREATER than main's 5190 (net-new tests added, none removed), and `bun run check:all` green.

AC13 (FILE SIZE): if src/tmux/dispatch.ts (605 lines on main) exceeds its budget ceiling, raising it is legitimate here because this is an additive behavior fix, NOT an extraction story. Record the raise with a one-line justification in the same commit. Do not delete unrelated code to stay under.
gotchas: The delivered-verdict polarity is counter-intuitive: geometryUnchanged === true means DELIVERED, not stuck. After send-keys+Enter the payload is SUBMITTED so the composer returns to its empty baseline; the wrap-collision case is geometry unchanged BUT the cursor row blank (payload still sitting unsubmitted). Read :529-539 and the header at :347-354 before touching anything, and do not 'fix' the polarity.
The idle gate at :503 runs ONCE, before the loop, not per attempt. Do not restructure it into the loop.

AC5's second half exists because the path of least resistance is `reason?:` optional, which would silently keep every existing fake and emit site compiling while modelling a shape that cannot distinguish the two modes. The compile break at the existing emit site (:553) is INTENDED. Fix it by passing 'retries-exhausted'; never by weakening the type. This is the exact CAM-363 decision-2 precedent.

test/dispatch.test.ts has 34 tests and EVERY one injects a fake sleepFn (injection points around :176, 206, 229, 247, 269, 292, 337, 379, 400, 421, 455, 492, 515, 546, 578, 619, 645, 679). Two are structurally coupled to synchronous sleep semantics: the test at :389-430 uses sleepFn itself as a state mutator keyed on `ms === SEND_KEYS_SETTLE_MS`, and a test around :310-345 stubs Date.now with a fake clock advanced ONLY by sleepFn to exercise the 30s deadline without real waiting. Reuse that fake-clock idiom for AC1-AC3 rather than inventing a new one, and do not disturb either existing test.

The `host.ts` narration path (makeNotifyOrchestrator, src/supervisor/host.ts:324-338) exposes NO sleepFn seam and no maxAttempts override, so it inherits every default. Do not add a seam there for this issue; it is CAM-361 surface.

push-undelivered is consumed well beyond dispatch.ts: src/supervisor/events.ts (the WorkerEventKind union at :164 and the detail interface at :528), adaptLogEventForPush in the host/sidecar wiring, and tests in test/issue.test.ts:329-392, test/supervisor/notify-orchestrator.test.ts, and test/integration/dispatch-geometry.test.ts. Adding a REQUIRED field means every constructor of this detail must be updated; sweep all of them rather than only the dispatch.ts site.

Do NOT run a full `bun test` sweep casually while the sidecar is live: it contends for CPU with the sidecar's own gate runs and has previously produced a false FIXES_PENDING. Resolve test-count questions statically via git diff where possible.

test/integration/dispatch-geometry.test.ts tests are `test.skipIf`-gated on real tmux availability and already use async bodies with `await waitForCondition` (test/helpers/wait-for-condition.ts). waitForCondition is TEST-ONLY and rejects on timeout; do not import it into src/.

Sidecar-executed surface (host.ts:330 -> dispatch.ts), so the operator must rebuild the binary and relaunch the sidecar after merge for this to take effect. Note it in the handoff; do not attempt the rebuild from inside a story.
domainTerms: idle gate: the pre-send waitForIdlePane call (dispatch.ts:503) that polls pane CONTENT via isOrchPaneIdle until the orchestrator pane is at a quiescent prompt or the deadline expires. Returns true meaning TIMED OUT.

delivery oracle: the post-send verdict at dispatch.ts:529-539, the conjunction of geometryUnchanged(baseline, after) and cursorRowStartsWithPrompt(...). Geometry-based, and measured only for an idle pane.
pane-not-idle path: the new branch taken when the idle gate times out. One unverified send, no retry, push-undelivered with reason 'pane-not-idle'.
retries-exhausted path: the pre-existing branch where the gate did NOT time out but the delivery oracle returned false for all maxAttempts.
